name: TrendRadar
description: Hot-topic monitor that aggregates trending news, filters it by your keywords and pushes AI-analysed digests.
whatItDoes: Tracks trending lists across many platforms, keeps only the topics you care about and delivers digests to chat and mail channels. Documentation is primarily in Chinese.
howItWorks: A scheduled Python job fetches trend lists, applies keyword rules and optional LLM analysis, and sends results through webhooks such as Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Slack, ntfy or email. A separate MCP service lets AI clients query the collected news. It runs on GitHub Actions, Docker or locally with uv.
